items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: And I was doing a lot of stuff for him.

ctx.x: Okay the first one is at 5:30 Jim Jordan, who was then the president of BBD and O but he had been a copywriter, the first copywriter to rise to the presidency. And I was doing a lot of stuff for him. And it was about 5:30 at night and I’m making dinner for the kids. And he says, “Anne, listen, the Sheraton account is in Boston but they haven’t been able to do this. It’s a telephone number and can you come in tomorrow at 8:30?” And so it was, he said, “They’re switching to the 800 number, so the number is…
Were you singing that in your head on the way?
